messages:
Sam G: Heads-up — deploybot just flagged a steady p95 drift in eu-canary during the late change window. Thinking we should hold the rollout and pin the version. Anyone see a reason not to?
DeployBot: :rotating_light: eu-canary: p95 latency 620ms over 5m window (threshold 500ms). Suggested action: HOLD rollout, run health checks, consider fallback to v2.3.1. Links: https://deploy/status/eu-canary
Marta C: +1 to hold & pin. If it's kv-cache warming, partial traffic rollback to previous stable might avoid a full revert.
Noah O: Agree with pin first. Can we do a staged traffic shift back to 2.3.1 for 30% -> 0% if metrics improve/worsen?
Jess P: I'll draft a short release-note blurb + customer note in #customer-ops. What exact version are we pinning to?
Sam G: Pin target: v2.3.1 (the one we used last week). Exec plan: hold -> pin -> monitor 10m -> escalate/rollback. Command to pin (ops):
```
/deploy pin --env eu-canary --to v2.3.1 --reason "p95 latency > threshold"
```
Marta C: If pin doesn't lower p95 in 10m we should rollback. Ops, can you prep the rollback command?
Ops Oncall: Oncall here — ready. Rollback command prepped: `/deploy rollback --env eu-canary --to v2.3.1 --force --reason "latency regression"`. I'll standby. Which SLA/contacts to notify if we escalate?
Noah O: Paging ENG_LEAD and SRE_LEAD if we hit rollback. Also notify the handful of early access customers (Jess to coordinate).
DeployBot: Action taken: HOLD placed on rollout by Sam G at 4800004325. Traffic pinned to v2.3.1 for 30% route slice. Telemetry: https://telemetry/trace/4800004325
Sam G: Thanks. Monitoring charts look noisy but trending down slightly. We'll wait full 10m. If p95 < 520ms for two consecutive 2m buckets we can revert the pin.
Jess P: Drafted customer-facing note and release-note blurb, posting to #customer-ops now. Short summary + what we're doing.
Marta C: Quick check — are there any backend infra changes in v2.3.1 we should call out? DB schema is same, only runtime kernel flag removed. Safe.
Noah O: 6m in: p95 at 540ms and continuing downward. Not stable yet. Ops, hold on rollback for now.
Ops Oncall: Acknowledged. Standing by for manual rollback if we cross 600ms again or error-rate doubles.
Sam G: 10m mark: p95 at 510ms, error-rate normal. I'm going to keep the pin for now and cancel the full rollback. Will run a canary-catalog sweep and follow up with postmortem doc.
DeployBot: HOLD cleared by Sam G at 4800004389. Pin remains at v2.3.1 for safety.
Jess P: Customer note sent: "We've observed transient latency increases in EU canary during today's change window. We've pinned traffic to a stable build while we investigate; no customer-facing errors detected."
Sam G: Closing loop here — manual hold + pin executed, rollback prepped but not needed. Postmortem & follow-ups in #eng-postmortems, I'll add timeline and metrics. :thumbsup:
